name: Bug Heuristics
when_to_use: Generate bug ideas around common failure modes while exploring a feature.

letters.description: What happens with no data, empty fields, or zero results?
What happens with missing/None values where data is expected?
What happens with zero, division by zero, or zero-length input?
What happens when the same operation is done twice?
What happens at the edges of ranges and limits?
What happens when multiple things happen at once?
What happens with a single element or single user?
What happens when input is of the wrong type or format?
What happens when access is attempted without permission?

example: Test resubmitting a form after a session expires, or importing an empty CSV file.
